scripts.check: scala-cli clean . && scala-cli compile src project.scala
scripts.examples:build: scala-cli --power package src examples project.scala --js -o examples/out -f
scripts.examples:watch: scala-cli --power package src examples project.scala --js -o examples/out -f -w
scripts.bench:noise: scala-cli --power package src bench/NoiseBench.scala project.scala --js -o bench/noise_bench.out.js -f && bun bench/noise.bench.ts
scripts.publish:local: scala-cli --power publish local src project.scala --organization xyz.trival --name trivalibs --project-version 0.1.0-SNAPSHOT
